test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences:

A. The technician stared at the blinking server lights.

B. The system had crashed at the worst possible time.

C. Every second meant thousands in losses.

D. But panic wouldn't help now.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentences need to be arranged logically to form a coherent paragraph describing the scenario.
 
• **Sentence B** is the most logical opening sentence as it sets the context by explaining the system crash: 
 
 
• "The system had crashed at the worst possible time."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C** follows logically as it emphasizes the urgency of the situation caused by the crash:
 
 
• "Every second meant thousands in losses."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A** comes next as it describes the technician's response to the situation:
 
 
• "The technician stared at the blinking server lights."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D** concludes the paragraph by highlighting the technician's focus despite the crisis:
 
 
• "But panic wouldn't help now."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **BCAD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The system had crashed at the worst possible time. Every second meant thousands in losses. The technician stared at the blinking server lights. But panic wouldn't help now."</div
